title: Mislay
summary: MISLA'Y, verb transitive To lay in a wrong place. The fault is generally mislaid upon nature. 1. To lay in a place not recollected; to lose. If the butler be the tell-tale, mislay a spoon so as he may

inlines.v: MISLA'Y, verb transitive To lay in a wrong place. The fault is generally mislaid upon nature. 1. To lay in a place not recollected; to lose. If the butler be the tell-tale, mislay a spoon so as he may never find it.
